card.name: The word hazardous before waste
card.fires_on: The word hazardous (or its ending in Hazard-ous) in regulatory text, especially just before waste, substances or tasks. It also fires on words like potentially before fatal.

modes.label: Scattered danger-adjacent words
modes.description: Occasional hits on potentially before fatal, or on stray punctuation and numbers in scripture or history passages.

card.writes: It suppresses the word danger and its variants, so it seems to stop the model repeating danger once hazard has been said.
card.plain: It spots the word hazardous in waste and safety rules and steers the model away from saying danger next.
